raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the EAR. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, and related parts should re-verify ECCN/Commerce Control List classification, license exception eligibility, and end-use/end-user screening before shipment. Note that this relief applies to civilian firearms only; items with military characteristics, restricted parties, or embargoed destinations remain controlled. Align US HTS lines (Chapter 93) and confirm Section 301 exposure and BIS Entity List screening for all consignees.
raw.content_zh: 美国工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支弹药在《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的许可与分类处理。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪及相关零部件的企业应在发货前重新核实ECCN/商业管制清单分类、许可例外适用性以及最终用途/最终用户筛查。注意该放宽仅适用于民用枪支；具有军用属性、涉及受限方或禁运目的地的物项仍受管制。应核对美国HTS第93章税号，确认301关税风险，并对所有收货人开展BIS实体清单筛查。

checklist.desc: Confirm each firearm, part, and ammunition item's ECCN or EAR99 status under the rescinded rule; document classification rationale and retain for audit.
Assess whether the eased rule enables a license exception (e.g., for sporting/civilian end use); confirm no military characteristics or restricted end use disqualifies the shipment.
Map 10-digit HTS lines for firearms and ammunition, verify Section 301 list exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all consignees, intermediaries, and end users against BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied persons lists; retain end-user/end-use statements.
Confirm destination is not embargoed or subject to UN/US arms restrictions; flag any dual-use or military end-use indicators before filing.
Maintain classification, screening, and licensing records per EAR Part 762 retention requirements to support post-shipment audits.
